pre_commit.content:
# Pre-commit hooks for code quality and formatting
# Install with: pre-commit install
# Run manually with: pre-commit run --all-files

repos:
  # Code formatting with Black
  - repo: https://github.com/psf/black
    rev: 24.10.0
    hooks:
      - id: black
        language_version: python3.11
        args: [--line-length=88]

  # Linting with Ruff
  - repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    rev: v0.6.8
    hooks:
      - id: ruff
        args: [--fix]
      - id: ruff-format

  # Type checking with mypy
  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/mirrors-mypy
    rev: v1.11.0
    hooks:
      - id: mypy
        args: [--ignore-missing-imports, --no-implicit-optional]
        stages: [manual]  # Only run manually, not on commit (too slow for CI)
        additional_dependencies: [
          "pydantic>=2.0.0",
          "typer[all]>=0.9.0",
          "replicate>=0.25.0",
          "requests>=2.31.0",
          "pillow>=10.0.0",
          "fpdf2>=2.7.0",
          "mistralai>=0.1.0",
        ]

  # Trailing whitespace and file ending checks
  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v4.5.0
    hooks:
      - id: trailing-whitespace
      - id: end-of-file-fixer
      - id: check-yaml
        args: [--safe]
      - id: check-toml
      - id: check-merge-conflict
      - id: mixed-line-ending

# Configuration
ci:
  autofix_commit_msg: "chore: auto format with pre-commit"
  autofix_prs: true
  autoupdate_commit_msg: "chore: update pre-commit hooks"
  autoupdate_schedule: weekly
  skip: [mypy]  # mypy can be slow, skip in CI
  stages: [commit]

ruff_config.content:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61.0"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[tool.setuptools]
packages = ["agency_toolkit"]

[project]
name = "agency-toolkit"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "CLI tools for agency workflow automation"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
license-files = ["LICENSE"]
authors = [
    {name = "Kim Eisele", email = "your.email@example.com"}
]

classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "Topic :: Office/Business",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12"
]

dependencies = [
    "typer[all]>=0.9.0",
    "pillow>=10.0.0",
    "fpdf2>=2.7.0",
    "pydantic>=2.0.0",
    "toml>=0.10.0",
    "python-slugify>=8.0.0",
    "jsonschema>=4.0.0",
    "replicate>=0.25.0",
    "requests>=2.31.0"
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
google = ["google-generativeai>=0.3.0"]
mistral = ["mistralai>=0.1.0"]
interactive = ["questionary>=2.0.0"]
dev = [
    "pytest>=7.4.0",
    "pytest-cov>=4.1.0",
    "black>=23.0.0",
    "ruff>=0.1.0",
    "mypy>=1.0.0",
    "google-generativeai>=0.3.0",
    "mistralai>=0.1.0",
    "questionary>=2.0.0",
    "pyinstaller>=6.0.0"
]

[project.scripts]
toolkit = "agency_toolkit.cli_app:cli_entrypoint"

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 88
select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "UP", "N"]

[tool.black]
line-length = 88
target-version = ["py310", "py311", "py312"]

[tool.mypy]
strict = true
warn_return_any = true
warn_unused_configs = true
ignore_missing_imports = false
namespace_packages = true

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
python_files = ["test_*.py", "*_unit.py", "*_integration.py"]
python_functions = ["test_*"]
markers = [
    "integration: marks tests as integration tests (deselect with '-m \"not integration\"')",
    "unit: marks tests as unit tests"
]
